name: PVC DWV pipe (Schedule 40)
description: White Schedule 40 PVC drain, waste and vent pipe (solid or cellular core) in 10ft lengths, solvent-welded; sold 1-1/2in to 4in. Plumbing is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: PVC specific gravity 1.40 ± 0.02 (ASTM D792), physical properties of PVC/CPVC pipe (pvcpipesupplies.com data sheet). Weighed as solid pipe material.

name: PVC Schedule 40 pressure pipe
description: White Schedule 40 PVC pressure pipe, solvent-welded, for cold water lines, irrigation and pool plumbing (not for hot water); 1/2in to 2in. Plumbing is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: PVC specific gravity 1.40 ± 0.02 (ASTM D792), physical properties of PVC/CPVC pipe (pvcpipesupplies.com data sheet).

name: CPVC pipe (CTS)
description: Cream CPVC copper-tube-size pipe for hot and cold water supply, solvent-welded; 1/2in and 3/4in. Plumbing is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: CPVC specific gravity about 1.55 (typical compound value; not transcribed from a data sheet in this pass).

name: PEX tubing
description: Flexible PEX water supply tubing sold in coils, joined with crimp-ring (or expansion) fittings; 1/2in to 1in. Plumbing is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: crosslinked polyethylene specific gravity about 0.94 (typical HDPE base resin; not transcribed from a data sheet in this pass).

name: Copper pipe (Type L)
description: Rigid Type L copper water pipe in 10ft lengths, soldered (sweated) joints; 1/2in to 1in. Plumbing is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: density of copper (C12200) about 8.94 g/cm3, handbook value (not transcribed from the CDA Copper Tube Handbook in this pass).

name: ABS DWV pipe
description: Black ABS drain, waste and vent pipe (usually cellular core), solvent-welded with ABS cement; 1-1/2in to 4in. Common in the West; check it is allowed locally. Plumbing is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: ABS specific gravity about 1.04-1.06 (typical resin value; not transcribed from a data sheet in this pass).

name: Cast iron soil pipe (no-hub)
description: Service-weight no-hub cast iron soil pipe in 10ft lengths, joined with shielded no-hub couplings; quieter than plastic for drains. 2in to 4in. Plumbing is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: gray cast iron density about 7.2 g/cm3, handbook value (not transcribed from the CISPI handbook in this pass).

name: Galvanized steel pipe
description: Threaded galvanized steel pipe; now mostly for repairs, gas-free outdoor runs and supports rather than new water lines, which corrode inside. 1/2in to 1in. Plumbing is for the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: carbon steel density 7.85 g/cm3, handbook value.

name: PVC fitting
description: A typical Schedule 40 PVC solvent-weld fitting, priced as a 3/4in 90-degree elbow; counted once per glued PVC joint. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 32 g for a 3/4in Sch 40 elbow over a 1.6x1.6x1.05in box (44 cm3).

name: CPVC fitting
description: A typical CPVC CTS solvent-weld fitting, priced as a 3/4in 90-degree elbow. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 20 g for a 3/4in CTS elbow over a 1.4x1.4x1.0in box (32 cm3).

name: ABS fitting
description: A typical ABS DWV solvent-weld fitting, priced as a 2in hub coupling. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 77 g for a 2in hub coupling over a 2.7x2.7x3in box (359 cm3).

name: PEX crimp fitting
description: A brass PEX insert fitting plus its copper crimp ring, priced as a 1/2in 90-degree elbow and one ring. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 40 g for a 1/2in brass elbow and ring over a 1.5x1.5x0.7in box (26 cm3).

name: Copper sweat fitting
description: A wrought copper solder-joint fitting, priced as a 3/4in 90-degree elbow. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 45 g for a 3/4in cup x cup elbow over a 1.6x1.6x0.95in box (40 cm3).

name: Galvanized fitting
description: A galvanized malleable iron threaded fitting, priced as a 3/4in 90-degree elbow. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 180 g for a 3/4in elbow over a 1.75x1.75x1.35in box (68 cm3).

name: No-hub coupling
description: A shielded no-hub coupling (neoprene sleeve with stainless band and clamps) that joins cast iron soil pipe, priced as a 3in coupling. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 500 g for a 3in shielded coupling over a 4.2x4.2x4in box (1157 cm3).

name: Ball valve (3/4in brass)
description: A quarter-turn brass ball valve to shut off a water line, sweat, push-fit, PEX or threaded ends. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 0.75 lb for a 3/4in brass ball valve over a 3.5x2.5x2.2in box.

name: Frost-free hose bib (sillcock)
description: A frost-free sillcock: the valve seat sits inside the heated wall so the outdoor faucet does not freeze. Pick a stem length that reaches past the insulation. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: Woodford 17PX-14 listed at 1.78 lb (Walmart) over a 14x3x2.5in box.

name: P-trap (1-1/2in)
description: A 1-1/2in P-trap under a sink or tub drain; its water seal keeps sewer gas out. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 0.4 lb over a 7x4x2in box.

name: Air admittance valve
description: A one-way vent valve (e.g. Oatey Sure-Vent) that lets a fixture drain breathe where a roof vent is hard to run. Not allowed everywhere; check the local code. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 0.35 lb over a 3x3x5in box.

name: Vent pipe roof flashing (boot)
description: A roof flashing boot that seals around a plumbing vent pipe where it passes through the roof, for 1-1/2in to 3in pipe. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: about 0.5 lb thermoplastic boot over a 12x12x5in box.

name: Toilet (two-piece)
description: A standard two-piece floor-mount toilet with a 12in rough-in, set on a wax ring over a 3in closet flange. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: American Standard Cadet 215TA105 85.4 lb (Ferguson listing) over a 30x18x28in envelope.

name: Vanity with sink and faucet
description: A 24-30in bathroom vanity cabinet with a sink top, plus a centerset faucet. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: Glacier Bay Huckleberry 30in vanity with top, 130.7 lb assembled (Home Depot Canada) over its 30x19x34in size.

name: Outdoor shower (wall-mount kit)
description: A wall-mount outdoor shower kit (head, arm and valve) on an exterior wall, as at a pool house; drain it or use a frost-proof valve where it freezes. For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: Signature Hardware 401595 outdoor shower 6.2 lb (spec sheet) over an 84x24x12in envelope (head arm out from the wall).

name: Water heater (40 gal tank)
description: A 40 gallon electric or gas tank water heater. Usually installed by a licensed plumber with a permit (gas venting, T&P relief valve, expansion tank). For the materials list only, not simulated.
source: Estimate: Rheem XE40M06ST45U1 spec sheet (2020): 106 lb shipping weight, tank 20-1/4in diameter x 50-1/2in to the connections; over a 20.25x20.25x50.5in box.
